import unreal
target='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'

if comp is None or rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Actor component or RT missing')
unreal.RenderingLibrary.export_render_target(comp,rt,unreal.Paths.project_saved_dir(),'SSPR_RT_Actor_Realtime')
